New report identifies 3 objectives that strategic cooperation on AI could advance:

➡️ improving understanding of AI capabilities and risks

➡️ promoting reliable AI development while managing proliferation

➡️ preparing to mitigate and respond to harms

bit.ly/4rqcqRq

Resignations and retirements among teachers and principals spiked nationally after the 2021–2022 school year.

New RAND data show that turnover rates have declined steadily since that time. bit.ly/4lMgme1

RAND researchers have developed a new suite of tools to help policymakers and all Americans understand just how much can change with every line in the federal budget.

New episode of Policy Minded: bit.ly/40Nd28L

A loss of safety, opportunity, and a sense of normalcy have shaped an entire generation of young Palestinians.

"Left unaddressed, this latent damage will outlast any ceasefire or physical reconstruction." bit.ly/4lxRFlp
This new report examines how actors in the AI realm—states, firms, groups, and individuals—might promote beneficial AI development and mitigate risk through strategic cooperation. bit.ly/3PxCpt6
New research brief on demographic trends in China. ⬇️ bit.ly/4s7L3N3

More and more young people are turning to AI when they feel anxious, stressed, or alone. What happens when a chatbot becomes a de-facto therapist?

New episode of Policy Minded: bit.ly/3Pe6cH9

"International policymakers and multilateral institutions must give Gaza's social foundations the same attention as its physical infrastructure. Youth rehabilitation is a strategic investment in regional stability." bit.ly/4bu8Tvs

As China's workforce shrinks and financial pressures grow, the impact will be felt worldwide, changing the global security environment, economic relationships, and international alliances. bit.ly/4uugbIa

The RAND Budget Model is a game changer for understanding the long-term implications of budget decisions and tax policies.

In this episode of Policy Minded, RAND's Jeffrey Wenger explains how it works. bit.ly/4s23m6C
67% of students we surveyed in December 2025 said that using AI for homework harms critical thinking. That's up from 54% earlier in the year. bit.ly/4rEb31L

Elevated educator turnover can negatively affect students' academic performance.

This new report explores turnover trends since the pandemic: bit.ly/4lZiqj1

China is facing a population upheaval.

How China handles the crisis will shape not only its own future but also the stability of the region and the global economy. bit.ly/40uybVi
We modeled potential costs and savings of the Trump retirement accounts proposal: bit.ly/4rvq8mj
What does the evidence say about young people's use of AI chatbots for mental health support? bit.ly/4uWFray
"The strategic logic is straightforward. If Taiwan falls, Japan faces a drastically different geopolitical reality." bit.ly/4t3t0rC

China has one of the world's lowest fertility rates, and its population decline is accelerating.

By 2050, China's population could lose 250 million people from its current 1.4 billion. That's nearly three-quarters of the current U.S. population. bit.ly/417UxMo

"The fact that the kids themselves are saying that [using AI for homework] is harming critical-thinking skills I think should be a canary in the coal mine."

RAND's Heather Schwartz discusses her new research on Marketplace: marketplace.org/episode/2026…
Experts: Tokyo can make a commitment to the U.S.-Japan alliance—and to Japan's own survival—by pledging to help sink China's ships if Beijing moves to invade Taiwan. bit.ly/40OvZIo
